title: Aquaculture Technician II
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: analyze, evaluate, and apply microbiological and genetic concepts, data, and laboratory techniques to manage the health and sustainability of aquaculture systems.
Analyze conditions for culturing aquatic species, and develop optimal strategies to maximize production, while minimizing environmental impact.

Design, justify, and communicate a business model for an aquaculture facility that integrates site selection, permitting, biosecurity, social license, production logistics (food creation/delivery/handling), and sustainable market delivery.
